name: Alpha ESS Battery
tagline: All-in-one inverter and battery systems for new or existing solar.
summary: AlphaESS SMILE systems combine the inverter and battery in one unit. The single-phase range runs from 3 kW to 5 kW of output, with storage from 4 kWh up to 60.6 kWh.
Models suit new solar installations or adding storage to an existing system, with monitoring through AlphaCloud.

image.alt: Alpha ESS Battery all-in-one home battery

highlights.title: All-in-one unit
highlights.text: The inverter and battery are integrated in a single unit.

highlights.title: Full discharge depth
highlights.text: 100% depth of discharge for maximum energy use.

highlights.title: Stackable design
highlights.text: Stacks for a quick setup and easy expansion.

highlights.title: 24/7 online monitoring
highlights.text: Track the system on the AlphaCloud web and app platform.

highlights.title: Backup ready
highlights.text: UPS ability with a built-in changeover switch.
